constraints.source: DB-04 | Distribution to the rack is 800 VDC nominal, two-wire, inside the 1500 VDC low-voltage limit | S5; S3 §5.2.1
800 VDC two-wire distribution shall run from the power-block output through DC switchboards and 6000 A-class busduct to parallel 1250 A row busways with 125 A tap cans

The Contractor shall supply 125 A 800 VDC power whips hardwired to the tap can behind a normally open contactor that closes only when the rack-side connector is mechanically locked and opens before the connector unlocks
IF-05 | Lot 3 to Lot 4 | 125 A 800 VDC interlocked whip behind a normally open contactor | S5
